edge_cases.case: NaN, Infinity, -Infinity or 1e999 in any input
edge_cases.expected: configuration error / exit 2; never hash or compare non-finite values

edge_cases.case: duplicate object keys
edge_cases.expected: configuration error naming duplicate key

edge_cases.case: negative rate or non-USD currency
edge_cases.expected: reject in v0.x or use currency-specific metric/rendering; never label arbitrary currency USD

edge_cases.case: expected literal string '<missing>' and field absent
edge_cases.expected: absent does not equal literal sentinel

edge_cases.case: scorer omits a declared metric or emits an undeclared one
edge_cases.expected: clean contract error; no denominator distortion

edge_cases.case: negative/boolean/NaN usage or latency from custom provider
edge_cases.expected: contract error recorded or run fails according to explicit policy

edge_cases.case: prompt/params/adapter changes while fixture output is reused
edge_cases.expected: request fingerprint mismatch; exit 2

edge_cases.case: candidate fails difficult items and scores well on survivors
edge_cases.expected: candidate-wide error/coverage rule fails; relative delta uses common cohort

edge_cases.case: metric applicable to different items on each side
edge_cases.expected: relative rule uses paired applicability and exposes paired coverage

edge_cases.case: latency exists for one fast item only
edge_cases.expected: coverage guard prevents misleading p95/mean gate

edge_cases.case: model/config/item names contain pipes, newlines, backticks, HTML or @mentions
edge_cases.expected: valid escaped Markdown; no accidental notification; HTML escaped

edge_cases.case: multi-megabyte or secret-like output
edge_cases.expected: selected disclosure profile redacts/truncates deterministically and records hash/length

edge_cases.case: fork PR lacks comment permission
edge_cases.expected: gate verdict still enforced; warning and job summary available

edge_cases.case: pull_request_target checks out untrusted head
edge_cases.expected: security guide says never do this with write token; reference workflow avoids it

edge_cases.case: self-hosted runner lacks gh or compatible Bash
edge_cases.expected: preflight error/warning and documented prerequisites; gate verdict remains distinguishable

edge_cases.case: process interrupted between report files
edge_cases.expected: atomic writes or clearly incomplete staging directory; manifest written last

edge_cases.case: duplicate/missing item IDs or dataset hash mismatch
edge_cases.expected: snapshot validation fails before scoring

edge_cases.case: response hash does not match raw response
edge_cases.expected: validation fails; no comparison

edge_cases.case: one applicable item produces 100% delta
edge_cases.expected: minimum-N/coverage guard can make relative metric unavailable/fail

edge_cases.case: extension registers an existing name
edge_cases.expected: duplicate registration rejected unless an explicit override mechanism exists
